workflow.name: research-agent-comparison
workflow.description: Compare two agent strategies for market research tasks: ReAct (iterative reason-act-observe) vs Plan-and-Execute (plan upfront, batch tool calls, synthesize). Demonstrates how different tool sequences can produce equivalent outcomes at different efficiency levels.

eval_run.name: ReAct vs Plan-and-Execute — Market Research
eval_run.description: Agent trajectory comparison: ReAct strategy iteratively reasons then acts, while Plan-and-Execute creates a full research plan before executing tool calls in batch. Highlights tool sequence divergence with comparable outcome quality.

cases.label: competitor-landscape-saas
cases.input: Analyze the competitive landscape for AI-powered customer support SaaS tools. Identify the top 5 players, their key differentiators, pricing tiers, and recent funding rounds.

output_data.text: I need to research AI customer support SaaS tools. Let me start by searching for an overview of the market.

input_data.query: top AI customer support SaaS tools 2024 market overview

results: Intercom AI
Zendesk AI
Freshdesk Freddy
Ada
Tidio AI

output_data.text: I found 5 major players. Now I need to get pricing and differentiator details for each one. Let me search for each individually.

input_data.query: Intercom AI pricing plans features 2024

results: Essential $39/seat, Advanced $99/seat, Expert $139/seat. Key feature: Fin AI agent handles 50% of support volume.

input_data.query: Zendesk AI pricing features competitive analysis

results: Suite Team $55/agent, Suite Growth $89/agent, Suite Professional $115/agent. Key feature: AI-powered ticket routing and sentiment analysis.

output_data.text: Two competitors researched. Continuing with the remaining three and then I need funding data.

input_data.query: Freshdesk Freddy AI pricing features

results: Growth $15/agent, Pro $49/agent, Enterprise $79/agent. Key feature: Freddy AI for ticket classification and canned response suggestions.

input_data.query: Ada AI chatbot pricing funding round

results: Custom enterprise pricing. Series C $130M (2022). Key feature: No-code AI agent builder, 70%+ automated resolution rate.

input_data.query: Tidio AI chatbot pricing features funding

results: Free tier, Starter $29/mo, Growth $59/mo, Tidio+ $499/mo. Series B $25M. Key feature: Lyro AI conversational chatbot.

output_data.text: I have funding for Ada and Tidio but need Intercom, Zendesk, and Freshworks funding data.

input_data.query: Intercom Zendesk Freshworks latest funding valuation 2024

results: Intercom: Series D $125M at $1.275B (2020), profitable since 2022. Zendesk: taken private by Hellman & Friedman for $10.2B (2022). Freshworks: IPO 2021, market cap ~$5.5B.

output_data.text: I now have all the data needed: 5 competitors with pricing, differentiators, and funding. Let me compile the final analysis.

I'll create a structured research plan first:
1. Identify top 5 AI support SaaS tools
2. Batch-search pricing for all 5
3. Batch-search funding/valuation for all 5
4. Compile competitive matrix
This approach minimizes round-trips by batching related queries.

input_data.query: top 5 AI-powered customer support SaaS platforms 2024 comparison

results: Intercom Fin
Zendesk AI
Freshdesk Freddy
Ada
Tidio Lyro

input_data.query: Intercom vs Zendesk vs Freshdesk vs Ada vs Tidio pricing comparison 2024

results: Comprehensive pricing comparison: Intercom $39-139/seat, Zendesk $55-115/agent, Freshdesk $15-79/agent, Ada enterprise custom, Tidio free-$499/mo.

input_data.query: AI customer support startups funding rounds valuation 2024 Intercom Zendesk Ada Tidio Freshworks

results: Intercom $1.275B Series D. Zendesk $10.2B take-private. Freshworks $5.5B IPO. Ada $130M Series C. Tidio $25M Series B.

output_data.text: All data collected in 3 searches. Compiling the competitive landscape analysis with differentiators, pricing tiers, and funding information.

cases.label: market-sizing-edtech
cases.input: Research the global edtech market: current size, projected CAGR through 2030, key segments (K-12, higher ed, corporate training), and the top 3 emerging trends driving growth.

output_data.text: I need to find edtech market data. Let me start with the overall market size and growth projections.

input_data.query: global edtech market size 2024 CAGR 2030 forecast

results: Global edtech market valued at $340B in 2024, projected CAGR 16.5% to reach $890B by 2030.

output_data.text: Good baseline numbers. Now I need the segment breakdown.

input_data.query: edtech market segments K-12 higher education corporate training market share 2024

results: K-12: 38% share ($129B), Higher Ed: 32% ($109B), Corporate Training: 22% ($75B), Other: 8% ($27B).

output_data.text: Have market size and segments. Still need the emerging trends.

input_data.query: edtech emerging trends 2024 2025 AI personalized learning

results: Top trends: (1) AI-powered personalized learning paths, (2) Micro-credentialing and skills-based hiring, (3) Immersive learning with AR/VR.

output_data.text: All data collected across three searches. Synthesizing the complete market analysis with size, CAGR, segment breakdown, and trend analysis.

Research plan for edtech market analysis:
1. Get overall market size + CAGR in one comprehensive query
2. Get segment data + trends in a second query
3. Synthesize findings into structured report

input_data.query: global edtech market size 2024 2030 CAGR forecast K-12 higher ed corporate training segments

results: Market $340B in 2024, CAGR 16.5% to $890B by 2030. K-12 38%, Higher Ed 32%, Corporate 22%, Other 8%.

input_data.query: edtech industry top emerging trends 2024 2025 growth drivers AI personalization micro-credentials VR

results: Three key trends: AI-powered adaptive learning (60% of new platforms), micro-credentialing replacing traditional degrees, immersive AR/VR classrooms.

output_data.text: All data captured in two efficient searches. Compiling structured analysis covering market size, CAGR, segment breakdown, and three emerging trends.

cases.label: due-diligence-fintech
cases.input: Conduct preliminary due diligence on the buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) sector: regulatory landscape, default rates, major players and their market positions, and risks for investors.

output_data.text: BNPL due diligence requires multiple angles: regulation, financial metrics, competitive landscape, and risk factors. I'll research each sequentially.

input_data.query: buy now pay later BNPL regulation 2024 CFPB rules

results: CFPB classified BNPL as credit card equivalent (2024). New rules require dispute rights, refund protections, billing disclosures. EU considering similar framework.

output_data.text: Good regulatory context. Now I need default rate data and financial health metrics.

input_data.query: BNPL default rates 2024 Affirm Klarna Afterpay delinquency

results: Industry average default rate 3.7%. Affirm: 2.5% net charge-off. Klarna: 1.8% credit losses. Afterpay: 1.1%. Late fees represent 8-15% of revenue for most players.

input_data.query: BNPL market leaders market share Klarna Affirm Afterpay 2024

results: Klarna: 34% global BNPL market, 150M users. Affirm: 18% US market, $16.7B GMV. Afterpay (Block/Square): 16M active users. PayPal Pay Later: fastest growing, leveraging existing 430M user base.

output_data.text: Have regulatory, financial, and competitive data. Still need investor risk factors.

input_data.query: BNPL investment risks 2024 recession credit cycle regulatory

results: Key risks: rising interest rates increasing funding costs, regulatory compliance costs, credit cycle exposure, merchant fee compression from competition, path to profitability questions.

output_data.text: Complete data set assembled. Compiling the due diligence brief covering regulatory landscape, default metrics, competitive positioning, and investment risk factors.

Due diligence research plan for BNPL sector:
1. Comprehensive regulatory + market landscape query
2. Financial metrics (defaults, revenue) + competitive positioning
3. Risk assessment compilation
Two search rounds should cover all four dimensions.

input_data.query: BNPL buy now pay later regulatory landscape CFPB 2024 Klarna Affirm Afterpay market share competitive analysis

results: CFPB credit card rules effective 2024. Klarna 34% market, Affirm 18% US, Afterpay 16M users, PayPal Pay Later growing fast.

input_data.query: BNPL default rates delinquency 2024 investor risks credit cycle interest rates profitability

results: Industry default 3.7%, Affirm 2.5%, Klarna 1.8%, Afterpay 1.1%. Key risks: funding costs, regulatory compliance, credit cycles, merchant fee pressure.

output_data.text: All four due diligence dimensions covered in two searches. Compiling preliminary brief with regulatory context, default rate analysis, competitive landscape, and risk factors for investors.
